'''September 2001 Raleigh tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Raleigh, NC on 8 September 2001. It is known from Corey "Gizman15" Boba's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2947">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-09-raleigh-nc-9-8-01d2947/ raleigh-nc-9-8-01], DeckTech (Corey "Gizman15" Boba, 9 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-09-raleigh-nc-9-8-01d2947/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Raleigh, NC
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
